description.value: The Orchard at Oliver is a motel, cabin, and RV park set within a working fruit orchard in Oliver, BC, a short walk from town and surrounded by wineries and golf courses. The property explicitly calls out the area's wide, flat roads as ideal for cycle tours and positions itself as a base for Okanagan cycling adventures. Guests enjoy a communal outdoor lounge with fire pits, complementary BBQs, a clubhouse kitchen, and seasonal fruit from the orchard trees.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and provides strong primary evidence. The /rooms and /facilites pages both explicitly confirm a dedicated secure bike store at no extra charge, with a note to inform staff at reservation. Laundry, vending machines, Wi-Fi, and nearby dining are all confirmed by website text. The OSM address uses 'Okanagan Highway' while the website consistently uses 'Highway 97' — these refer to the same road, so contact_confirmed.address is set to true but flagged as a minor concern.
concerns: OSM address field uses 'Okanagan Highway' while the website consistently lists 'Highway 97, Oliver, BC, V0H 1T9'; these refer to the same road but the OSM tag is less specific and omits city/postal code.
Website footer shows '© 2035' — an apparent template or placeholder error; not indicative of closure but worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel and RV park with a live website, bookable rooms, and multiple confirmed cyclist-friendly amenities. Strong candidate for the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Facilities page instructs cyclists to notify the property at time of reservation to arrange secure bike storage. Staff awareness of the full bike procedure (loaded touring bikes, e-bikes, trailers) is not explicitly confirmed on the website.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Dedicated secure bike store at no extra charge, confirmed on both the Rooms page ('Secure cycle storage available at no extra fee') and Facilities page ('we offer a dedicated secure bike store at no extra charge, just let us know when making your reservation')

Laundry.detail: Coin-operated guest laundry available to all guests, per the Facilities page

Nearby evening food.detail: Facilities page states 'From coffee and a croissant to fine dining meals Oliver has an abundance of great choices.'

Vending machines.detail: Snack vending station ('snack vending station') located in 'Big Room', offering cold drinks and snacks, per Facilities page

wow_evidence: dedicated secure bike store at no extra charge
